risk_flags.description: The promised test appears to check the grand total and presence of TOTAL, but not that the per-category breakdown is correct. That matters because the requester specifically asked year reports to match the monthly report's category breakdown.
risk_flags.span: with the same per-category breakdown the monthly report gives

risk_flags.description: The contract makes combined --year and --month behavior explicitly unsupported. That may be acceptable, but the requester should confirm whether ambiguous flag combinations should instead error clearly or have defined precedence.
risk_flags.span: using both is unsupported but at minimum does not crash

verdict.primary_risk: The main risk is that the added test may not actually protect the requested per-category yearly breakdown behavior.
